title: Avoid Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Waste Lines
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal waste line is a frequent error in drainage piping. Sanitary tees are engineered for vertical drops where gravity assists the directional change. When placed flat on a horizontal drain run, the short-radius turn restricts wastewater flow velocity, causing solid waste to accumulate and create severe pipe blockages over time. To ensure smooth flow and meet standard plumbing codes, always use a long-turn combination wye and eighth bend fitting when joining horizontal waste branches.

Avoid Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Waste Lines

Installing a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal waste line is a frequent error in drainage piping. Sanitary tees are engineered for vertical drops where gravity assists the directional change. When placed flat on a horizontal drain run, the short-radius turn restricts wastewater flow velocity, causing solid waste to accumulate and create severe pipe blockages over time. To ensure smooth flow and meet standard plumbing codes, always use a long-turn combination wye and eighth bend fitting when joining horizontal waste branches.
